essence: The prescribed mantra for this deity starts with the speech-seed, ends with the nail-letter, and closes with svāhā.
Laghuśyāmā is the deity and the speech-seed is declared to be her seed.
The practitioner should place speech-preceded delight on the head and māyā-beginning affection in the heart.
One should place will-power, knowledge-power, and action-power in that order.
One should place drāṃ as melting on the head and drāṃ as drying on the face.
